q_external.q: Does the system have connections to external systems?

q_unknown_target.q: Are there connections from or to unknown target systems?

yes.note: e.g. proxy system / ALG, sensitive data in flight.

no.note: e.g. proxy system / ALG — no backend storage required.

q_workstation_or_server.q: Is the system an office system (workstation) or a server?

q_data_used.q: What is the system used for or which data is processed?

test.note: Test system — productive data may not be used.

dev.note: Dev system — productive data may not be used.

source_note: Core (small, labelled 'core'): hosts/rules/zones exported from test_sentrywall_core.estate() — the exact fixture the 292-test suite runs against. Extended (large, labelled 'extended'): ~1,750 rules / ~1,750 hosts / 440 networks / 52 firewalls across a 16-region synthetic telecom topology (WEB/APP/MW/DB/CNF/DMZ/MGMT/SVC/DR/CLOUD/EXT) — realism layer for browsing and search, generated separately, not run through the engine's pytest suite.
